claims.title: Load-safe recovery: hidden preload, full wrench and guarded reaction witnesses

quoted_fields.interface: Three-point isotropic linear rigid-body spring model and exact opposed matched-law branches at the same effective point; individually constrained paths, known material/contact range and actual internal measurement or mechanical limiting. Guarded single-force-path witness must have no parallel bypass and a physically realized unloaded calibration gap supported elsewhere. Actual powered full-wrench exchange, tool access, reset and life remain obligations.
quoted_fields.failure: Linear elastic matching, coaxial cancellation and same effective point are essential. Finite spacing, geometric stiffness, mismatch, accessible internal strain or physical load limiting may remove ambiguity. Frozen radial-preload example neglects geometric stiffness and is not an all-probe theorem. Independent flexure is not jointly validated with rigid plate, not three-axis sensor or1kN250Nm exchange module. No measured life/material/sensorerror or full autonomous recovery.
